title: Pronunciation and Vocabulary (Theme 6: Weather and our environment)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for the sound (f, n, h, o), says it back, and matches it to the right word or picture.

floor.prerequisite: Hears the first sound of a word.
floor.question: Does "fan" start like "pan"?

steps: Say it in three words with pictures.
Say two words that differ by one sound; the child points.
contexts: a hat on a hot day

board.do: Wait for the child to point.
The child says the word back and traces its first letter.
Write fan and underline the sound.

checks.question: Which word starts with h: hat, cat, at?
Which word has the sound in "ball": dog, door, dot?
